entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Just to keep an eye on her until I can get there. I think I can get her to listen to me.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: She didn't last night.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: That's because she's not responsible for her own actions. She's suffering from some kind of paranoid psychosis.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Brought on by what?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I can't explain the exact mechanism, but it has to do with certain videotapes we watched... That we recovered from a crime scene.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Videotapes?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Videotapes that contain an electronic signal... That somehow induces violent behavior.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ sighs ] do you have any proof of this?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I'm working on that.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Whatever prompted her behavior, the fact remains that Scully is armed and obviously dangerous. I suggest you marshal whatever resources you have to make sure you find her first.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: [ phone ringing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Mulder. We pulled something off that videotape in Scully's room.
entries.speaker: Frohike

entries.text: What is it?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Something interesting. But we don't want to talk about it over the phone. Big brother may be listening.
entries.speaker: Frohike

entries.text: [ phone hangs up ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Here is the tape Scully was reviewing last night. We scanned samples of the tape onto disks.
entries.speaker: Frohike
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Digitized it.
entries.speaker: Langly
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Using some interpolating freeware we pulled down off the net, we were able to blank out the invisible frames.
entries.speaker: Byers
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: What am I looking at?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Well, this is the actual signal your cable trap device was emitting.
entries.speaker: Langly
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Of course, we slowed it down significantly. It's designed to cycle at 15 flashes per second... To induce what's known as the photic driving response.
entries.speaker: Byers
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Bring it home, boys.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: This device is stimulating electrical activity in the brain.
entries.speaker: Langly
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Studies into subliminal influence have shown a correlation... Between heightened suggestibility and the manipulation of this response.
entries.speaker: Byers
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Mind control?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: 57 channels of it.
entries.speaker: Langly
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Tachistoscopic images, like they use to sell popcorn at the movies. Both russian and american scientists have been working with them for decades.
entries.speaker: Byers
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: not to mention madison avenue. -
entries.speaker: Frohike
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: The naked lady in the ice cube.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Ah, one of my personal favorites.
entries.speaker: Frohike
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Why wasn't I affected?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: That's the one thing we haven't figured out yet.
entries.speaker: Frohike
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: This, uh, subliminal signal-- could color be a factor in it?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Maybe.
entries.speaker: Byers
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I'm red-green color blind.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: His inability to perceive the color red could render him immune to psychotropic effects.
entries.speaker: Byers
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ phone ringing ] but why design a color-dependent signal?
entries.speaker: Langly
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Why not?
entries.speaker: Frohike
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Red-green colorblind-- Mulder. That's only a small percentage of the male population.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Which still leaves the vast majority vulnerable to its effects.
entries.speaker: Byers
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I'll be right there.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: What happened?
entries.speaker: Frohike
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Maryland state police. They think they've found Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Is she okay?
entries.speaker: Frohike
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: No, um-- they think maybe I should come down and ID the body.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE LONE GUNMEN'S OFFICE ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ tires screeching ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Get in.
entries.speaker: Informant

entries.text: I can't talk to you right now.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: They're watching you. Get in before you get us both killed.
entries.speaker: Informant

entries.text: That's an interesting choice of words. My partner may be dead.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's not my concern.
entries.speaker: Informant

entries.text: The hell it isn't! We're here because of you!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Keep your voice down.
entries.speaker: Informant

entries.text: Who are you? Who do you work for?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We're wasting time. While you're chasing your partner, they're destroying the evidence.
entries.speaker: Informant

entries.text: Who?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Just follow the evidence. If you don't, by tomorrow the responsible parties will be out of your reach.
entries.speaker: Informant

entries.text: A state highway patrolman found the body... Off a rural highway at approximately 2:00 p.m. Nude, shot in the forehead. Are you ready?
entries.speaker: Coroner

entries.text: Let me do that. It's not her. Somebody has to call her mother.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We already tried. We weren't able to reach her.
entries.speaker: Coroner

entries.text: She's not answering her phone?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mrs. Scully. Is she here?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Uh, no.
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: You haven't been answering your phone.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: When I hear from her, I'll call you, okay?
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: I need to see her.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Fox, please. Go away. Go away!
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: Where is she?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Dana, put down the gun!
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: I'm here to help you, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I told you, mom. He's here to kill me.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm on your side. You know that.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Put it down, Dana.
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: Scully, listen to me very carefully. You don't know it, but you're sick with the same thing that drove those other people to murder. And whatever you think may be happening--
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Just step back.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Dana, you're not yourself. He's telling you the truth.
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: It's not the truth, mom. He's lied to me from the beginning. He never trusted me.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Scully, you are the only one I trust.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You're in on it. You're one of them. You're one of the people who abducted me. You put that thing in my neck! You killed my sister!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: That's not true, Dana.
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: It is.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I want you to listen to me.
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: Mom, just get out of the way!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You trust me, don't you? You know that I would never hurt you. That I would never let anybody hurt you. That's why you came here, isn't it? You're safe here. Put the gun down, Dana. Put it down.
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: [ crying ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Dr. Monsignor.
entries.speaker: Hospital Announcer
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: [ knock at door ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: [ newscaster, indistinct ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: How are you feeling?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Ashamed. I was so sure, Mulder. I saw things, and I heard things. And it was just like the world was turned upside down. Everybody was out to get me.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Now you know how I feel most of the time.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: I thought you were gonna kill me.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: I'm not surprised. I did some checking. Joseph Patnik thought he was murdering a bosnian war criminal, a man the media described as a modern day hitler. It turns out both Patnik's parents were holocaust survivors.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: I'm not following.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Helene Riddock was scared... That her husband was gonna be unfaithful to her. You see a pattern developing? What if this video signal... Somehow turned these people's anxieties into some kind of dementia? A virtual reality of their own worst nightmares.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Like me thinking that you'd betray me. I was so far gone, Mulder, I thought that you were gone to the other side.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: That cancer man, that man who smokes all those cigarettes. I was sure that I saw the two of you sitting in your car in the motel parking lot. You were reporting to him. You handed him a videotape. It... It was crazy.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Well, maybe not.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Well, somebody's behind this. We just don't know who.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: You think it could be him?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: I don't know. Why don't you try to get some rest? Dr. Lorenz?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Agent Mulder. I was just about to check in on your partner.
entries.speaker: Dr. Lorenz
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: What course of treatment have you outlined for agent Scully?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: At this point, nothing more than bed rest. We still haven't been able to determine what brought this on. As far as I can tell, there's nothing medically wrong with her.
entries.speaker: Dr. Lorenz
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Well, that didn't seem to be the case last night.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: No, it wasn't. It's got me puzzled. Her m.r.I. Was negative, but the spinal tap revealed high levels of serotonin in her brain.
entries.speaker: Dr. Lorenz
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Do you think that would account for her strange behavior?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: High serotonin levels have been associated with mania. But the good news is, as of this afternoon, her levels are pretty much back to normal.
entries.speaker: Dr. Lorenz
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Dr. Lorenz, uh, would you have made a diagnosis of amphetamine abuse for someone in agent Scully's condition?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Not given her serotonin levels. No, that wouldn't make any sense.
entries.speaker: Dr. Lorenz
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: [ phone dialing, ringing ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Braddock heights. Yeah, I need the number for the frederick county psychiatric hospital.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: [ phone ringing ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Ward three.
entries.speaker: Nurse
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: This is Fox Mulder with the federal bureau of investigation. I need to talk to dr. Stroman, please.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: I'm sorry. Dr. Stroman is no longer here. I believe he's returned to Washington.
entries.speaker: Nurse
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Know where I can reach him?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: I'm not sure. He left us a local number. It's around here somewhere.
entries.speaker: Nurse
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: That's it.
entries.speaker: Nurse
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  MAY 2 ·  1:43 PM

entries.text: You want me to go first this time?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Damn straight. I haven't had a chance to clean the room yet. He just checked out. But with all the excitement, I don't blame him.
entries.speaker: Proprietor

entries.text: Do you charge for local calls?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Of course.
entries.speaker: Proprietor

entries.text: Then you'd have a record of all calls made from here?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I'll get it.
entries.speaker: Proprietor

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Here you go.
entries.speaker: Proprietor

entries.text: Thanks. Thank you. Hey, danny. It's Mulder. I need you to check a number for me.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's what he told me, Stroman.
entries.speaker: Cable Technician

entries.text: Then where is he? He said he'd be here.
entries.speaker: Dr. Stroman

entries.text: He'll be here.
entries.speaker: Cable Technician

entries.text: It's almost 7:00. I can't wait any longer. There's no sign of him!
entries.speaker: Dr. Stroman

entries.text: [ gunshots ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: You're too late, agent Mulder.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: Now that you've destroyed all the evidence.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You were told this would happen. You made your choice.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: I just didn't know I was working for you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I had no alternative. I was being watched too closely. I couldn't risk compromising myself.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: Why kill them if you wanted me to expose them?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Those were always my orders. I was just hoping you'd get to them first.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: And uncover what? What were they trying to do? Manipulate people's behavior? Alter their decision-making process? What to buy? Who to vote for?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You think they'll stop at commerce and politics?
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: Where will they stop?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's where you failed, agent Mulder.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: Don't lay this off on me. You pulled me into this situation... Because you didn't have the courage to reveal the truth yourself.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Feel better now?
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: You're a coward! You work in the shadows. You feed me scraps, hoping that I could piece it together. You've made me risk my life, you've risked my partner's life... And you never risk your own! You're not walking away from this.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You're risking your life right now. You failed. This is your success? Killing me? The truth is, you need me, agent Mulder.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: [ sirens wailing in distance ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: This is your final report, agent Mulder?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Yes, sir.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I see more questions here than I do answers. You don't know who manufactured the device you found or what its purpose was.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: [ knock at door ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: No, sir.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Scully, welcome back.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I'm sorry I'm late. I just got back from the documents section.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What did you find out about the two men Mulder found executed?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: The cable company employee had no criminal record. In fact, there was nothing remarkable about him whatsoever. We found a medical license under the name "dr. Henry Stroman"... In falls church, virginia. He died in 1978.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What about their killer?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: He remains an unknown subject.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Have you completed your work?
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.speaker: X

entries.text: Well, it proves nothing. What about, uh, Mulder's source?
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: He's been eliminated.
entries.speaker: X

entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
